description: Windows eye-care suite with screen color and brightness controls, reading aids, and break reminders.
##: Installer Type: Inno Setup payload extraction (one-directory application)
notes: Scoop extracts only the Inno Setup {app} payload; it does not run the vendor setup tasks or create the vendor Start Menu, Desktop, or Startup shortcuts. Settings are stored under %APPDATA%\EyeGuard and WebView data under %LOCALAPPDATA%\EyeGuardWebview. The optional Launch on Startup setting creates an HKCU Run entry; disable it before uninstalling to avoid a stale startup reference.
